title: Contact, Lemi Orhan Ergin
description: How to reach Lemi Orhan Ergin about talks, podcasts and community events.

blocks: Write to me about talks, podcasts and community events. I no longer take on training or consulting work; my time goes to Craftgate. You can also reach me on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/lemiorhan) or [X](https://x.com/lemiorhan).
